text:
mike_h: Heads up — eval harness on master started showing soft output drift vs canary for the new quantized llama-2 variant. Goldset failure rate jumped from 0.3% -> 4.6% on last nightly run.

anya_r: what changed in CI? metric definitions or tokenizer versions?

devon: i noticed the harness logs include a new exec path: it prefers ONNX for quantized models now. we also got a small infra image bump yesterday. could be interaction.

zara_s: can you paste a minimal failing example? short diffs help triage faster.

mike_h: here's a typical failing snippet from the harness (truncated):

```
EXPECTED: "Order a pizza"
ACTUAL:   "Order pizza"
METRIC: exact_match dropped from 1 -> 0
```

multiple short-token truncations and small punctuation drops.

devon: interesting — looks like either tokenizer normalization or decoding postprocess changed. which tokenizer hash do logs show?

mike_h: tokenizer hash in the run metadata: tk_202603_hash: 7a3f1e. previous stable runs used 6b2d9c.

kevin_m: @anya_r CI image bump included python:3.11-ubuntu and onnxruntime bumped too. that was the only infra change landed around the time the drift started.

anya_r: i spun up the canary environment locally with old vs new image. reproduces only on new image and only when the runner chooses ONNX execution; torch path looks baseline.

devon: i'll bisect runtime selection changes, but quick test: which CL flipped auto-select behavior? i think commit c4a1b9d (runtime: prefer-onnx-for-quant) landed yesterday.

zara_s: easy test: run the runner with `--force-exec torch` and `--force-exec onnx` and compare.

mike_h: ran that already: `--force-exec torch` -> baseline metrics match. `--force-exec onnx` -> drift reproduces. ONNX path is suspect.

kevin_m: i'll grab the ONNX logs and kv-cache dumps. mike, can you attach a minimal full example dump?

mike_h: uploaded minimal reproducer to s3://redwood-test/onx-drift/217654/onx-drift-217654.tar.gz and linked in the CI run. logs include this snippet:

```
onnx_runner: decode_step token=47 logits_shifted=-0.003
postprocess: stripped trailing token at 102
```

also saw `softmax` fp diffs on the order of 1e-3 in intermediate logits.

devon: that pattern is consistent with reordered fused kernels in newer onnxruntime. do we know which onnxruntime version the new image has?

kevin_m: confirming: image bumped onnxruntime 1.14 -> 1.15. release notes mention fused kernel reorder and QDQ handling changes. could produce argmax differences on short sequences.

anya_r: proposed action plan: 1) revert prefer-onnx-for-quant (c4a1b9d) in canary to stop the immediate drift, 2) pin onnxruntime to 1.14 in CI infra, 3) run targeted goldset on canary and check delta. objections?

zara_s: agree — this is blocking nightly release. revert in canary only first to limit blast radius.

devon: i'll open a revert CL now (runtime/selector: revert c4a1b9d) and also raise an infra PR to pin onnxruntime.

mike_h: :thumbsup: tag me when the revert lands and i'll re-run the goldset immediately.

kevin_m: pushed an artifact with extra ONNX trace logging to s3://redwood-test/onx-drift/217654/traces/ — if drift remains after pin we'll need a kernel-level bisect.

eval-bot: goldset run queued on canary -> ci-217654-gold (expected ~40m). I will post results in this thread when complete.

anya_r: also adding a defensive CI test: compare tokenization checksum + decode checksum between backends for a small smoke set. catches tokenizer/postprocess drift quickly.

mike_h: i'll create a ticket with sample pairs + reproducer and assign.

devon: created issue #1179: "onnx q8: tokenization/postprocess delta on short sequences" and linked logs + CLs.

zara_s: i'll monitor the canary job and escalate to #incidents if it fails hard.

mike_h: thanks everyone — feel free to DM if you need extra reproducer cases.
